svg.title: The Storyteller keeps official advisories apart from the headlines and points out the one that names your CVE
svg.desc: A board with two lanes. On the left, official advisories from CISA and vendors arrive one at a time in their own lane. On the right, security headlines scroll; one carries a terracotta CVE tag and a pulsing ochre ring because it names a vulnerability in your packages. The Storyteller gestures toward it.
